rules.title: Every rule and correction becomes code, permanently
Prefer a positive invariant over a blocklist
Never route around a broken shared component
One shared module per invariant
Ad-hoc scripts live in `scripts/` and get deleted
Always verify current live status; never answer from memory
Read, do not pattern-match
Never filter your own diagnostic output
A guard is not a guard until a deliberate break makes it fire
Keep replies short
Write for a non-developer
Claim only what a command proved
Report the outcome, keep the receipts
Never speak as the human
One channel, one post a day
Everything an agent raises waits for the daily post
Copy bans
Never announce as a bot in a crawler user agent
Decide alone: anything reversible inside the pipeline
Decide alone: volume of change
Escalate: a real tradeoff, not a guess about one
Escalate: anything irreversible or outside the pipeline
Never touch: operator and org membership
Cold outbound is never auto-sent
Owner of an open record is derived, never trusted
Call tasks belong to call operators only
Real clients before internal test orgs
Near-duplicate supplier names reach one operator
The lead names the operator, every other surface follows
Never fabricate, approximate or infer a price
A foreign price is published only through one conversion
FX rates refresh daily, not intraday
Agents may never invent a contact detail in an outgoing body
Guessing a recipient is allowed; guessing content is not
Only a same-run verification counts as a confirmed email
Density: bulk for solids, specific gravity for liquids
A dealbreaker grade is a hard specification
Aliases never add a qualifier the input lacked
A write that fails is never silent
An unstated currency is a question, never a dollar sign
The same company held twice is surfaced, never merged
An operator's correction re-anchors a price, it does not freeze it
A captured price carries the words it was read from
Extraction records what it did not take
Every rung of a tiered quote is its own row
A later source fills a blank, it does not overwrite a checked value
A shipping cost is a number or it is nothing
Delivery cost is per pack tier when pack size changes it
Delivery-cost extraction is opt-in per client
Delivery-cost extraction is audited every run
A delivery cost is never fabricated
The primary price pull runs on the fleet's own platform
A marketplace that deals by email becomes a second, direct supplier
A price row belongs to one lane and no writer may cross
Only a structural verdict is terminal
"Needs a human" is a display flag, never a queue exit
A zero-result pass is never "this market is empty"
Retry limits are a spend control, and must be named
Never give up on a lead with no contact
No hidden caps on a worklist
A withheld price is a job, not an outcome
The record of a failure is never proof of success
A paced job stops itself and says where it stopped
Blocked is not empty
Search the trade's name, not ours
Aliases must reach the relevance filter too
Aliases never re-specify (see DATA-09)
Zero is not empty (see PERS-03)
A platform is never the supplier
Duplicate suppliers have one definition
Same name, different grade, is not a duplicate
A source's own paging must advance
A self-supplied material is not sourced
Checkout decides what a marketplace is
Nothing auto-sends (see AUTO-06)
Marketplace storefronts get drafted, on a different channel
Never guess a contact on a platform host (see DATA-05)
One email per supplier, one thread
No draft into an existing thread may ignore what was already said
Internal notes never reach a supplier
Never offer to stop contacting a supplier
Copy bans are applied at staging (see COMM-08)
Supplier asks are staggered
Stalled conversations get chased
A cancelled outreach must release its alias
A rejected draft is not redrafted
"denied" in Tenkara does not mean "do not contact"
Do-not-contact has two authors, and one gate
A discard has to say why, or it is a silent kill
Every idempotency key is scoped to the organisation
Never fold leads from two clients into one draft
Shared natural keys carry the organisation in the database too
An ambiguous inbound reply goes to triage, not to a guess
The live data is audited every morning
Cross-client lookups are scoped at the query, not filtered after
Membership in `organization_ids` tests the whole set, never a fixed slot
A supplier shared across clients never suppresses a client-owned supplier
A supplier id is checked against its owners before it is stored
Unknown is not ambiguous
Unaudited edge
Suppliers are unique per client
Never ship a native OS dropdown
Everything lives on the client's own tabs
Never build a screen over data this application cannot write to
The Inbox is a triage queue, not an email client
Clutter is a bug, not a tradeoff
Flagged work needs a home
Seed a real client before judging a view
A one-click write needs a way back
RETIRED: the CSV export sweep
A withheld value shows its reason where it renders
A placeholder must never look like a value
Push to `main`
Never stage everything
A red build is silent, so build before you push
Rules are checked before the build
Confirm what production is actually serving
The deploy gate must not depend on one machine
Deploy and schema move together
Weekly rules review
